claims.statement: The Met places Villanovan culture approximately between 900 and 500 BCE and identifies it as a predecessor of Etruscan culture.

evidence.locator: Opening prose paragraphs on Villanovan chronology, Etruscan culture and metalwork
evidence.note: Approximate archaeological chronology, overlapping the emergence of Etruscan culture. These are not two successive states with a sharp boundary; map locations remain unresearched.
